name: DMRcate
model_likelihood: Local F(mu,nu) statistics; Gaussian-smoothed null approximated by a moment-matched scaled chi-squared variable.

estimand: Regions ranked by P value, with genomic coordinates and constituent CpG counts.
data_input: Probe-indexed methylation measurements, experimental-design matrix and optional contrast matrix.
tunable_settings: Analysis option; bandwidth lambda; kernel scale sigma=lambda/C; adjusted-P cutoff (usually 0.05).
